Gold Polishing & Repair

Searching for gold jewellery repair near you, or gold polishing near me in Sargodha? Old or damaged gold jewelry doesn’t need to be replaced it can be restored. Our expert craftsmen clean, polish and repair rings, bangles, necklaces and bridal sets back to a like-new finish, including old gold jewellery cleaning for pieces passed down for generations.

From a loose clasp to a dull, decades-old piece passed down in the family, bring it to our Sarafa Bazar shop for an honest assessment and a quick, fair-priced repair. If you’d rather sell old gold or ask about a gold exchange in Sargodha, our team can guide you through that too.

  • Expert repair of clasps, joints and settings
  • Professional polishing to a like-new finish
  • Quick turnaround service
  • Fair, transparent pricing agreed before work begins
